reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited § 12.3 affirmatively records that Customer has made no no-hire (or non-compete/exclusivity) commitment and remains free to hire anyone responding to general recruitment — this matches the preferred position of no non-solicit binding Customer.
No redline or counterparty comment was produced, which is correct for a compliant finding; the paragraph is returned unchanged.

The failed deterministic checks (duration ≤ 12 months, general-solicitation carve-out) are fallback-wording heuristics that are inapplicable where no non-solicit covenant exists at all; they do not undermine the compliance call.
Correctly declines to flag § 12.4 (restriction on Vendor) since that provision benefits our party, consistent with the playbook's instruction not to flag clauses favourable to us.
